description: (1) 안개 전투 나가기(выход_из_боя)가 이미 시작된 세이브(phase 3, 결과 비어 있음)에서 아무것도 안 하고 끝나던 문제: 전투를 정리하고 원래 화면으로 이동. (2) #food_base가 $meal_id를 비우지 않고 76개씩 덧붙여 세이브가 커지고 로드가 느려지던 문제: 시작 때 목록을 비움.

edits.new:
if jo9_fate['phase'] = 3:
  ! JO9 MOD START BATTLE_EXIT_REENTRY_20261116
  ! The exit already ran (result cleared) but the battle screen is still shown, e.g. a save made at that moment: leave the battle instead of doing nothing.
  ! Fog battles only (mode 1). Arena, colosseum and catfight results read this state, and a stored return target could replay a finished event, so those are left alone.
  if $итог_боя = '' and jo9_fate['mode'] = 1:
   jo9_fate['mode'] = 0
   jo9_fate['phase'] = 0
   $return_lock = iif(is_home = 1, 'main_screen', 'city_menu_form')
   gs '$combat_variable_reset'
   gs '$newloc'
   gt '<<$return_lock>>'
  end
  ! JO9 MOD END BATTLE_EXIT_REENTRY_20261116
  exit
 end

!FOOD DATABASE
! JO9 MOD START FOOD_BASE_NO_LEAK_20261116
! The list is rebuilt below on every refresh; without this reset each load appended another copy (an old save held 28804 entries instead of 76).
killvar '$meal_id'
! JO9 MOD END FOOD_BASE_NO_LEAK_20261116
